summary.text: Kevin Moynihan is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 19-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jim Walsh.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Aberdeen City Councilmember and a line cook.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Moynihan graduated from James Island High School and earned an associate degree from Brown Mackie College in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as chef.
In his survey answers, he said he grew up the son of an Air Force technical sergeant and has worked with his hands his entire life, in construction, private residences and commercial kitchens.
Moynihan described his campaign as worker-focused and independent and said he has taken a pledge to refuse corporate PAC money.
